metadata.title: Platform Time Synchronization and Sources

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for acquiring, validating, and synchronizing authoritative time from trusted sources in a controlled, accountable, and defensible manner.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Time synchronization protocols (NTP, NTS, PTP), authoritative clock sources, hardware clocks, and upstream time dependencies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern governing how time is sourced and synchronized without embedding time semantics or enforcement policy.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Time synchronization and source selection inherit baseline trust assumptions defined in Platform Time Core.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Reliable and integrity-protected network transport is required for time synchronization.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Authenticated time sources and secure time protocols rely on cryptographic identity and trust anchors (e.g., NTS).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced as contextual guidance for cryptographic evidence and signature timeliness. This guidance informs the defensibility of time sources but does not define platform time governance or enforcement.

metadata.remarks: Platform Time Synchronization and Sources defines how time is acquired, synchronized, and justified across the platform. It ensures that time used by consuming security and governance services can be defended as originating from trusted sources, supporting cryptographic validity, auditability, and forensic reconstruction.

components.title: Authoritative Time Sources
components.description: Defines which time sources are considered authoritative for the platform.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise or manipulation of upstream dependencies used as authoritative time sources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Selection and validation of trusted time sources using authenticated and integrity-protected channels.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authoritative time sources are explicitly defined and governed.

components.title: Time Synchronization Mechanisms
components.description: Controls how platform systems synchronize time with authoritative sources.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Integrity degradation through manipulation of time synchronization behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity-protected and authenticated time synchronization channels.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time synchronization mechanisms are configured explicitly and restricted to approved behavior.

components.title: Time Dependency Control
components.description: Governs upstream dependencies and trust relationships used for time synchronization.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Discovery or exploitation of implicit, undocumented time dependencies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit declaration and governance of time synchronization dependencies and trust boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time synchronization dependencies are explicitly defined, reviewed, and governed.
